# Step3 Bootstrap Documentation

## Overview
Step3 Bootstrap creates instance 003 with advanced compiler integration and blockchain macros. It demonstrates the evolution from manual fixes to fully automated generation.

## Architecture

### Source Files (Templates)
- `src/airdrop.rs` - Pure functions for blockchain operations
- `src/compiler_macros.rs` - Compiler integration macros  
- `src/blockchain_macros.rs` - Macros wrapping airdrop functions
- `src/bin/test_compiler.rs` - Test suite for all macros

### Generated Files
- `build.rs` - Generates lib.rs with proper module declarations
- `flake.nix` - Enhanced Nix environment with LLVM
- All source files copied with headers

## Key Features

### Function-First Design
```rust
// airdrop.rs - Pure functions
pub fn create_meme_token(name: &str) -> MemeToken { ... }
pub fn execute_airdrop(token: MemeToken, recipients: Vec<String>) -> AirdropExecution { ... }

// blockchain_macros.rs - Macros wrapping functions  
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! meme {
    ($name:expr) => { crate::airdrop::create_meme_token($name) };
}
```

### Ultimate DeFi Expression
```rust
defi!(create meme "pepe", and airdrop to "SOL123abc");
```

### File Headers
All generated files include headers:
```rust
// filename.rs - Description
// Generated by step3_bootstrap - Advanced Compiler Integration
```

## Build Process
1. `step3_bootstrap` copies source files to `instances/003/`
2. `build.rs` generates `lib.rs` with module declarations
3. Cargo builds with proper module structure
4. Test suite validates all functionality

## Success Criteria
- ✅ No manual changes required
- ✅ Clean compilation (warnings only)
- ✅ All macros functional
- ✅ Ultimate DeFi expression works
- ✅ Proper file headers
- ✅ Function-first architecture
